recommended_option: rebuild 50% of the lost monthly spend
headline: Riverside Retail's spend is down across nearly every category — hold a full account review, not a single-lever fix.
rationale: Revenue is down 18.9% first half vs second half (trend -1.83%/month) with two lines gone entirely and six more declining across six different categories — Power Tools, Electrical Accessories, Safety Basics, Precision Hardware, Diagnostic Equipment, Consumables. Orders are also fragmenting: average order value down 43.4%. This is whole-book decline, not one product or one discount.
why_not_more_aggressive: 100% rebuild assumes recovering all ₹28,951/month lost, before anyone has established why the customer is fragmenting orders — premature commitment.
why_not_less_aggressive: 33% only recovers ₹9,554/month and leaves ₹19,397/month short — too small a target given decline spans six categories.
expected_result: Rebuilding 50% of lost spend recovers ₹14,476/month in revenue (₹4,225/month margin, ₹50,706 over 12 months), but leaves the account ₹14,475/month short of the healthy threshold.
what_to_do: Schedule a business review with Riverside Retail's buyer covering the decline across Power Tools, Electrical Accessories, Safety Basics, Precision Hardware, Diagnostic Equipment, Consumables and Cleaning & Maintenance.
Raise the two lines that stopped entirely: PT-Cordless Drill 18V (was ₹24,824/month) and CN-Cutting Blade 10pk (was ₹4,997/month), and ask directly why.
Ask about order fragmentation directly: average order value down 43.4% while orders per month rose from 1.17 to 1.67 — check if part of the basket now goes elsewhere.

Build a recovery plan targeting ₹14,476/month of the ₹28,951/month lost, prioritising EA-Cable Gland Set (was ₹16,368/month, now ₹2,429/month) and PH-Precision Torque Wrench (was ₹8,856/month, now ₹3,493/month).
Set a follow-up review in 3 months to check whether the targeted ₹14,476/month has materialised.
talking_points: Your monthly spend with us has fallen from ₹175,870 to ₹146,919 — what's changed on your side?
You used to order the Cordless Drill 18V and Cutting Blade 10pk every month — neither has been ordered since March 2026.
Your order sizes are down 43.4% even though you're ordering more often — is part of the basket going elsewhere?
check_before_acting: Confirm whether PT-Cordless Drill 18V and CN-Cutting Blade 10pk were discontinued by Riverside Retail or sourced from another supplier.
Establish whether a competitor or an internal budget change is behind the order fragmentation.
Verify there is no contract or service issue driving the pattern before proposing commercial terms.
what_is_left_over: ₹14,475/month remains short of the ₹28,951/month lost. Closing it needs recovering more of the declined lines, especially EA-Cable Gland Set (was ₹16,368/month) and PH-Precision Torque Wrench (was ₹8,856/month).
downside_if_wrong: If the cause is competitive displacement rather than something fixable in conversation, the ₹28,951/month lost per month may not return regardless.
timing: Within 4 weeks, before next quarter's ordering cycle
how_we_will_know_it_worked: Monthly spend moves from ₹146,919 toward the ₹161,395 target within 3 months.
PT-Cordless Drill 18V or CN-Cutting Blade 10pk reappear in monthly orders.
Average order value recovers from its current fragmented, -43.4% level.
